title: Correction Remediation Adapters
principle: Confirmed remediation intent should become concrete private repair drafts without letting the public frontend mutate memory or knowledge sources.
public_repo_rule: GitHub Pages may render adapter draft metadata only. Raw memory text, document chunks, transcripts, provider keys and session tokens stay behind protected backend routes.

backend_route.purpose: Prepare memory scope drafts, knowledge source review packets and collection split proposals from confirmed application receipts.

ui_contract.auto_prepare: applyRemediationStep automatically calls prepareRemediationAdapter when the backend returns an application receipt

scenarios.expected: A successful Apply gate automatically requests a protected adapter draft from the active backend.
Users can retry adapter preparation from the latest apply receipt without entering secrets or raw content.
Memory corrections prepare scope/expiry review drafts with memory IDs and manual review gates only.
Knowledge corrections prepare source review packets or collection split proposals with source IDs only.

next.label: Protected remediation commit policy
next.reason: Adapter drafts now exist. The next slice should add explicit backend policy for committing selected memory/knowledge repairs with preview, audit and rollback.
